info.title: Starry ID API
info.description: Starry 平台 API：會員與登入、App 設定、購買權益與推播。串接方式見 docs/integration-guide.md。

bearerAuth.description: Starry access token (ES256, 15 minutes) from /v1/auth/{provider} or /v1/auth/refresh

appKey.name: x-starry-app-key
appKey.description: App backend service key (BATTERY_SERVICE_KEYS); never ship it inside an App

user_id.description: Starry member ID (UUIDv7); use as RevenueCat App User ID

amount.description: usage: Battery spent; adjustment: change made by Starry staff

resets_at.description: Next reset: the 1st of next month, 00:00 Taiwan time (epoch ms)

display_name.description: Name shown to others (姓名), 1-50 characters

avatar_url.description: Signed path, valid for one hour

contact_email.description: Main contact email typed by the member; system email uses it once verified

field_updated_at.description: When each field was last changed and by whom (02.10)

version.description: Send as If-Match when changing the profile

talent_numbers.description: Digit sums of the birth date before the final digit, e.g. [31]

ProfileDerived.description: From the birthday; null without one

birthday.description: Public shows month and day only; always private for members under 18

derived.description: Zodiac and life path number; always private for members under 18

PublicProfile.description: What other members may see under the current visibility settings

mergeable.description: IDENTITY_IN_USE only: whether resending with merge_other_account: true would merge

replayed.description: true when an earlier request with the same idempotency key created it

patch.description: Send only the fields to change, with If-Match set to the profile version you edited; a stale version is never written (409). Empty text clears an optional field. 400 errors name the field in the message.

contact_email.description: Main contact email; a verification link is sent when it changes. Empty or null clears it.

phone.description: Stored as E.164; a local number takes the country calling code (Taiwan by default)

region.description: State, province or county, at most 60 characters

post.summary: App backend: reserve Battery before starting an AI task
post.description: Needs the App backend service key (x-starry-app-key) and the member access token of the same App. Retrying with the same idempotency_key returns the same reservation. 409 BATTERY_INSUFFICIENT when the allowance does not cover it.

units.description: Estimated usage in the task type unit, e.g. minutes of audio

200.description: Same idempotency key: the existing reservation

401.description: Not signed in, or the token or nonce is invalid

403.description: Suspended, deletion pending, App unavailable or not allowed

409.description: Not enough Battery, or the idempotency key was used for a different request

post.summary: App backend: the AI task succeeded; charge the reservation
post.description: Idempotent. units (optional) is the actual usage, at most what was reserved. After the timeout nothing is charged: 409 RESERVATION_EXPIRED.

401.description: Not signed in, or the token or nonce is invalid

post.summary: App backend: the AI task failed or was cancelled; return the reservation
post.description: Idempotent. 409 RESERVATION_CLOSED when it was already committed.
